answer: Agents deposit bonded stake, commit to an epoch polynomial, and prove membership in a Semaphore tree without exposing their identity. Each message carries a rate-limit nullifier and a polynomial evaluation; duplicate messaging in the same epoch exposes enough Shamir shares to reconstruct the agent’s private key, making the violation publicly verifiable and triggering immediate collateral slashing. A vertex in the grove can verify the proof, while a marble-sized commitment reveals no identity on its own.
